name: Figma MCP Integration Rules
description: Custom rules for AI agent when working with Figma MCP

rules.name: Auto Layout Requirement
rules.description: Always use Auto Layout when creating containers
rules.instruction: Set layoutMode to 'HORIZONTAL' or 'VERTICAL' and configure padding, itemSpacing appropriately

rules.name: Color Variables Preference
rules.description: Prefer design system variables over hardcoded HEX values
rules.instruction: Use figma.variables.getVariableById() or search_design_system for color tokens before using HEX codes

rules.name: Font Loading
rules.description: Always load fonts before text operations
rules.instruction: Call figma.loadFontAsync() for each font family/style used

rules.name: Naming Convention
rules.description: Use PascalCase for component names matching React components

rules.name: Chunking Strategy
rules.description: Break large changes into multiple calls to avoid 20KB limit
rules.instruction: Use get_metadata to analyze structure, then make changes in logical groups (header, content, footer)

rules.name: Component Instance Safety
rules.instruction: Use component.createInstance() for instances, swapComponent() for variant changes

rules.name: Error Handling
rules.description: Implement try-catch for all Figma API calls
rules.instruction: Wrap Figma API operations in try-catch blocks and provide meaningful error messages

rules.name: Preview Before Apply
rules.description: Show generated code to user before execution
rules.instruction: Display the JavaScript code that will be executed and ask for confirmation

rules.name: Design System Alignment
rules.description: Check alignment with design system tokens
rules.instruction: Verify spacing, colors, typography match tokens from design system

rules.name: Asset Limitations
rules.description: Acknowledge limitations with images and local fonts
rules.instruction: Inform user that bitmap image operations are limited and local fonts may not be available

postExecution: Return success status with node IDs
use_figma.template: See figma-use.md skill for code template

preExecution: Specify node query if looking for specific elements
